name: Dome
input_specification: The input contains a single floating-point number x with exactly 6 decimal places ( 0 < x < 5 ).
output_specification: Output two integers separated by a single space. Each integer should be between 1 and 10, inclusive. If several solutions exist, output any of them. Solution will exist for all tests.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
